spec.title: HashiStack / Service Mesh (Envoy)
spec.description: Consul Connect sidecars on every platform root: inbound HTTP golden signals at the public listener, TCP traffic, upstream health, mTLS handshake errors and sidecar resources. `service` is the parent service, not the -sidecar-proxy registration.

spec.title: Sidecars live
spec.description: Envoys reporting LIVE.

spec.title: Inbound HTTP
spec.description: Requests reaching the public listener of the selected HTTP services.

spec.title: 5xx ratio
spec.description: Share of inbound requests answered 5xx.

spec.title: Inbound p95
spec.description: 95th percentile request time at the public listener (sidecar to app and back).

spec.title: Active connections
spec.description: Open downstream connections on every listener of the selected sidecars.

spec.title: App connect failures
spec.description: Sidecar could not connect to its own app (local_app). The app is down or not listening.

spec.title: Upstream connect failures
spec.description: Failed connections to mesh upstreams (intention denials surface at the source as these).

spec.title: Unhealthy upstream members
spec.description: Upstream endpoints Envoy knows about but considers unhealthy.

spec.title: mTLS errors /s
spec.description: TLS failures on inbound listeners and outbound clusters.

spec.title: Circuit-breaker overflows
spec.description: Connections/requests shed by Envoy circuit breakers.

spec.title: Leaf cert runway
spec.description: Seconds until the soonest inbound mTLS leaf of the selected sidecars expires.

spec.title: Sidecar memory
spec.description: Heap allocated across the selected Envoys.

spec.title: Requests by service
spec.description: Inbound HTTP request rate.

spec.title: Errors by service
spec.description: 4xx and 5xx responses per service.

spec.title: Inbound latency
spec.description: Request time quantiles across the selected services.

spec.title: p95 latency by service
spec.description: Slowest services float to the top of the legend.

spec.title: TCP connections opened
spec.description: New TCP-proxied connections (postgres, ssh, OCI doors and other non-HTTP services).

spec.title: TCP throughput
spec.description: Bytes in + out through TCP proxies.

spec.title: Active downstream connections
spec.description: Open connections per sidecar.

spec.title: Active upstream connections
spec.description: Connections each service holds to its mesh upstreams.

spec.title: Upstream connect failures / timeouts
spec.description: Failed or timed-out upstream connects. Empty is healthy.

spec.title: Upstream HTTP 5xx
spec.description: 5xx returned by upstreams, including the sidecar's own app (local_app).

spec.title: Retries and resets
spec.description: Retries and upstream-reset requests.

spec.title: Upstream endpoint health
spec.description: Healthy / known endpoints per upstream cluster. NaN = no endpoints (the upstream is not registered).

spec.expr: sum by (service, envoy_cluster_name) (envoy_cluster_membership_healthy{envoy_cluster_name!~"local_app|local_agent|self_admin",nomad_namespace=~"$namespace",service=~"$service"}) / sum by (service, envoy_cluster_name) (envoy_cluster_membership_total{envoy_cluster_name!~"local_app|local_agent|self_admin",nomad_namespace=~"$namespace",service=~"$service"})

spec.title: Inbound mTLS handshakes
spec.description: Successful inbound TLS handshakes.

spec.title: TLS failures
spec.description: Handshake, verification, SAN and missing-certificate failures. Empty is healthy.

spec.title: Leaf cert runway by service
spec.description: Seconds until each sidecar's inbound mTLS leaf expires.

spec.title: Sidecar memory
spec.description: Envoy heap per sidecar.

spec.title: Sidecar uptime
spec.description: Seconds since each Envoy started. A recent restart sorts first (an in-place restart can come back with an anonymous token).
